clinical_review: DRAFT — written by the engineering team as a starting point. Must be reviewed and approved by the Clinical Lead before use with real clients.
name: Solution-focused
description: Inspired by solution-focused brief therapy practices (preferred future, exceptions, scaling, strengths). Our own wording.

scale.meaning: 1 = not present in this session, 3 = partly present, 5 = strongly and skilfully present

dimensions.label: Preferred future
dimensions.description: Inviting a detailed description of the client's preferred future.

anchors.3: The preferred future is mentioned but not developed.
anchors.5: A rich, detailed picture of the preferred future is built.

dimensions.label: Exceptions and what's working
dimensions.description: Noticing and exploring times when things are already a little better.

anchors.5: Exceptions are actively sought and explored in detail.

dimensions.label: Scaling
dimensions.description: Using scales to notice progress and identify small next signs.

anchors.5: Scaling used well to notice progress and small next steps.

dimensions.label: Strengths and compliments
dimensions.description: Noticing and reflecting back the client's resources and efforts genuinely.

anchors.5: Specific, genuine acknowledgement of resources and effort.

dimensions.label: Using the client's language
dimensions.description: Building on the client's own words and meanings.

anchors.1: The therapist reframes in their own terms.
anchors.5: Consistently builds on the client's own words.

dimensions.label: Small, concrete next steps
dimensions.description: Ending with small, achievable signs or steps chosen by the client.

anchors.5: Small, concrete steps chosen by the client.
